projects.title: Budget Portfolio Application
projects.description:
Technologies used: Django, Python, HTML/CSS, JavaScript, AWS RDS, PostgreSQL

•	Created a Budget portfolio web application to track budget spending by categorizing expenses and counting total number of expense transactions made.
•	Used AWS RDS and PostgreSQL to store budget project name, amount of expenses made, category of expenses, date of transactions made, and handled POST request to display stored data.

projects.title: DNA Sequence Translation
projects.description:
Technologies used: Django, Python, Pandas, Matplotlib, HTML, JavaScript

• Developed DNA Translation web application for bioinformaticians and researchers to visually identify protein distribution of DNA sequence using python.
• Used Pandas library for data manipulation and analysis of interpreted DNA sequence and Matplotlib library for plotting manipulated data for visualization.
